layer_independence.reference_atlas: frozen — changing it invalidates everything above
layer_independence.component_registry: may add evidence fields; must not change component identity
layer_independence.biochemical_ontology: may re-theme freely; does not touch atlas coordinates
layer_independence.component_theme_weights: may re-weight; recomputed from registry + ontology
layer_independence.reference_normalization: recomputed only if the atlas changes
layer_independence.bsv: may change aggregation/normalisation math; documented in equations
layer_independence.interpretation_engine: domain context + evidence prose; no numeric effect on BSV

principle: The ontology can evolve without changing the frozen Raman coordinates.
